description: Scripted events for the mock platform layer. Days are 1-based offsets from monitoring_start. These events stand in for things real platforms do to test accounts so the detection, alerting, retry and reporting paths can be exercised deterministically.

events.detail: Too Many Requests returned by mock X API on the first two attempts
Page admin role downgraded; pages_manage_posts no longer granted
401 invalid_token: access token expired and refresh token was not rotated
Account flagged by platform integrity checks; API returns account_restricted
Access token reaches end of lifetime in 3 days
Session invalidated after a password change on the linked account
Page no longer returned by /me/accounts for the connected user
